description.en: An army of limbs approaches -

description.en: Death beast appears

description.ja: 『機動武闘伝G ガンダム』より、デスアーミーのバリエーション機“デスビースト”がＨＧシリーズで登場！
description.en: From "Mobile Fighter G Gundam ", Death Army's variation machine " Death Beast" is now available in the HG series!

description.ja: 特徴的な四脚部を新規パーツを交えて再現。折りたたまれたデスアーミーの脚部を背面へマウントさせる接続ジョイントや
description.en: The characteristic quadrupeds are reproduced with new parts. A connection joint that mounts the legs of the folded Death Army on the back.

description.ja: 飛行形態を再現するオプションパーツ等を用意し、特徴的なスタイリングを完全再現。また、デスライフルや表情付新規左手パーツが付属。
description.en: Optional parts are available to reproduce the flight form, and the unique styling is completely reproduced. Also included is a death rifle and a new left hand part with facial expressions.

description.ja: ●　デスビーストの特徴的なシルエットを新パーツを交えて再現
description.en: ● Reproduce the Death Beast's distinctive silhouette with new parts

description.ja: デスアーミーから、四脚が特徴的なデスビーストの姿にするための専用脚部パーツを新規造形で再現。
description.en: From Death Army, special leg parts are reproduced with new modeling to create the Death Beast with its distinctive four legs.

description.ja: 各脚部がそれぞれに可動する他、新規造形の足首パーツを差し替えることで飛行形態の再現が可能。
description.en: In addition to each leg moving independently, it is possible to reproduce the flight form by replacing the newly sculpted ankle parts.

description.ja: 背面ジョイントパーツ
description.en: back joint parts

description.ja: 背面にデスアーミーの脚部をマウントするジョイントパーツを新規造形で用意。
description.en: Joint parts to mount Death Army's legs on the back are newly molded.

description.ja: ●　デスライフルを新規再現。各種オプションパーツをセット！
description.en: ● Newly reproduced Death Rifle. Set various optional parts!

description.ja: デスビーストの特徴的な武装デスライフルが新規造形で再現。さらに、演出の幅を広げる表情付新規左手パーツが付属。
description.en: Death Beast's characteristic armed death rifle is reproduced with a new model. In addition, a new left hand part with expressions that expands the range of production is included.
